as_told.title: Tipler disc time machine as flying saucer

plain: A physicist named Frank Tipler is said to have described, in the 1970s, a time machine shaped like a rapidly spinning disc, which looks very much like a flying saucer. A researcher named Mike Masters tells Michels this, tracing it through earlier work on time travel by Einstein, a physicist named van Stockum and the mathematician Kurt Gödel, and saying Tipler shrank those models down to something finite: a fast-rotating ring, sphere or disc. Michels repeats it on a later episode without naming a source, calling Tipler a contemporary of a physicist he calls Wheeler and saying the Tipler disc is a flying saucer. If the comparison holds, UFOs might be time machines, perhaps flown by humans from the future.
